$comment: Apparatus raw: numbered closing-bracket refs → matching margin notes → per-scholar opinions. Enums in raw_waqf_apparatus.enums.json.

target_word.description: Full phrase inside the bracket before the first dash, exactly as printed (not shortened to the last word)

verdict_label.description: Sajawandi letter from matn bracket; null if unresolved in matn

verdict.description: Mapped Sajawandi ruling; null iff verdict_label null

margin_ref.description: Western digits of the footnote number touching the closing ﴾, e.g. ﴾(٨) → 8. If no number touches ﴾, take the FIRST footnote number met inside this waqf's own reasoning clause. null only if neither exists. Apparatus only when this matches a margin (N) note.

text.description: Only this waqf: its bracket(s) plus its own reasoning clause (e.g. ﴿أمنتم﴾ وقفه لحق الحذف، ولابتداء الشرط في حكم آخر وهو التمتع.). Never neighbouring waqf brackets.

apparatus.description: Only notes whose margin number equals this waqf.margin_ref. Empty [] if margin_ref is null or no matching margin note.

text_page.description: Page where the margin note (N) appears

raw_text.description: Full margin note text for that number. If the note ends with '=' and the next page's margin starts with a '=' block, append that continuation here.

continuation.description: Only when the note on its own page ends with '='. null if the note is complete.

status.description: read = next page margin was available and merged; missing = not available

page.description: Page the continuation was read from; null if missing

suggested.description: PASS 3 ONLY (separate pass, never written by pass 1/2). AI-inferred extra waqf / ibtida points justified by this note's content (scholars disagree on stopping, or stopping/starting changes meaning). null if nothing is warranted.

target_word.description: Word after which a stop is suggested

scholars.description: Scholar names (same value as opinions[].scholar: canonical spelling if known, else name as printed) whose statements support this suggestion; [] if none

start_word.description: Word where a restart (ibtida) is suggested

symbol_witness.description: Only if matn lacked a letter and margin states one. Else null. Do NOT invent.

opinions.description: One object per scholar opinion. Scholars use final verdict words (حسن/كاف/تام/…), not Sajawandi letters.

scholar.description: Scholar name. STEP 1: if it is one of the known canonical names (examples; map kunyas/variants via scholar_alias_hints) use that EXACT spelling. STEP 2: otherwise write the scholar's name as printed in the note, short common form (e.g. أبو حيان, نافع, أبو حاتم) without honorifics (الإمام/العلامة/رحمه الله). STEP 3: use "unknown" ONLY when the note gives no name at all (e.g. قيل / بعضهم / غيره) or the name is unreadable.

verdict.description: Final ruling word as stated (حسن, كاف, تام, …) — NOT a Sajawandi letter

comment.description: Optional short note about this scholar's view

apparatus.raw_text: (٨) وهو حسن عند ابن الأنباري والأشموني . وكاف عند الداني . انظر : الإيضاح ١ / ٥٢٩ ، والمكتفى ( ١٧١ ) ، والمنار ( ٤٧ )

rules: apparatus ONLY when the waqf has a margin_ref AND margin has the same number
margin_ref: number touching ﴾; else the first footnote number inside the waqf's own reasoning clause; else null
text = this waqf's bracket + its own reasoning clause only
margin note ending with '=' continues on the next page's margin ('=' block at top): merge into raw_text if that page is available, set continuation.status=read; else status=missing
suggested is written ONLY by pass 3 and never changes any pass 1/2 field
Split each scholar into a separate opinions[] row
opinion.verdict is final wording (حسن/كاف/تام/…), not ط/ج/…
opinion.scholar: canonical name (exact spelling) if known; else the name as printed in the note; "unknown" only if no name is given
missing_symbol / symbol_witness ONLY if matn has no letter and margin states one (basis=page_prose)
If verdict_label non-null: verdict MUST equal verdict_mapping[verdict_label]
